rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for giving permission or giving someone something they have asked for.

example.english: The boss finally agreed to grant me leave.
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 zung1 jyu1 bei2 ngo5 fong3 gaa3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the grant is official permission or authorization.

example.english: The school formally decided to grant students permission to use mobile phones on campus.
example.traditional: 校方正式准許學生喺校內使用手機。
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 zing3 sik1 zeon2 heoi2 hok6 saang1 hai2 haau6 noi6 si2 jung6 sau2 gei1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a monetary grant or a government allocation of funds.

example.english: The government gave a grant of ten million dollars this year to improve the school buildings.
example.traditional: 政府今年撥款一千萬蚊改善校舍。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gam1 nin4 but3 fun2 jat1 cin1 maan6 man1 goi2 sin6 haau6 se3

rows.note: Use this for financial support given to a person, student, or organization rather than an official budget allocation.

example.english: I received a grant from the school, so I can pay my tuition.
example.traditional: 我收到學校嘅資助，交到學費喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou2 hok6 haau6 ge3 zi1 zo6 gaau1 dou2 hok6 fai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the approval or granting of permission, such as permission for a project.

example.english: I finally got the grant for my project approved.
example.traditional: 我個計劃終於獲得批准喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 gai3 waak6 zung1 jyu1 wok6 dak1 pai1 zeon2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when granting means agreeing to a request or wish.

example.english: They finally agreed to grant my request and accompany me to the doctor.
example.traditional: 佢終於答應我個要求，陪我去睇醫生。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 daap3 jing3 ngo5 go3 jiu1 kau4 pui4 ngo5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1

rows.note: Use this in written or religious language for bestowing a blessing, quality, or power.

example.jyutping: jyun6 tin1 ci3 jyu5 nei5 ping4 on1

rows.note: Use this for the legal transfer or conveyance of property, especially when the grant is documented by deed or writing.

example.english: The deed states the grant of the property to the buyer.
example.traditional: 份契約列明物業轉讓予買家。
example.jyutping: fan6 kai3 joek3 lit6 ming4 mat6 jip6 zyun2 joeng6 jyu5 maai5 gaa1
